name: smwgraphics-real-bout-fatal-fury-8x16-dialogue-fonts
title: Real Bout Fatal Fury - 8x16 Dialogue Fonts
description:
This is a selective collection of the English alphabet fonts used in SNK fighting game Real Bout Fatal Fury. It is sized 8x16 and works best against non-black, non-white background. This also comes with Spanish and Portuguese orthography.

BG2 sheet contains the basic English alphabets and sentence symbols and BG3 contains the rest. If you're short of space and only need to use English, you can omit BG3.

This font uses 3 monochrome colors, which are mapped to the global SMW palette on Row 4.
